svg.title: Galaxy Tab S10 Lite — gray
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. Portrait, 10 units/mm. Body 165.8 × 254.3 mm; centered display derived from 277 mm full-rectangle diagonal and 1320 × 2112 pixels. Original illustration: placement, corner radii, camera details and finish swatches are approximations. Sources: https://news.samsung.com/global/galaxy-tab-s10-lite-a-value-packed-tablet-for-everyday-needs; https://www.samsung.com/uk/tablets/galaxy-tab-s/galaxy-tab-s10-lite-grey-128gb-wi-fi-sm-x400nzareub/
